name: country-service
description:
## Country Service
Manages country data. Exposes state for `countries`, `loading`, and `error`, along with `loadCountries` to fetch from the GraphQL API.

variables.name: loading
variables.description: Indicates if countries are being loaded.

variables.name: error
variables.description: Stores error message if loading fails.

variables.name: loadCountries
variables.description: Fetches country list from API and updates state.
